note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 Tatra Defence Vehicle Pandur II 8x8 product sheet, with the tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation retained for the fields the product sheet does not publish. The registry marks the product sheet primary_held true; the held bytes are the TDV PDF. TDV produces the Pandur II 8x8 under licence from General Dynamics European Land Systems. The product sheet publishes the cruising range, the speed, the fully automatic ZF transmission and the Cummins ISLe engine; those fields are grade claimed at the manufacturer tier. It publishes no dimensions and no weight, so the dimensions, weight, power and payload fields remain on the tier-5 compilation at grade claimed. The speed disagrees with the tier-5 figure; both are recorded and neither is averaged.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Infobox, weight row, minimal protection entry
operating_weight_kg.state: weight published as 17.3 t with minimal protection; the same row publishes 22 t with additional protection and 20.1 t as the amphibious limit; the tonne taken as 1,000 kg

engine_model.state: engine published as a Cummins ISLe 450 HPCR 8.9 litre in-line 6 turbo-diesel

net_power_kw.state: engine published as 335 kW, with no net basis stated

transmission_type.state: fully automatic ZF transmission published for the six cylinder inline Cummins ISLe engine

max_speed_kmh.state: speed published as 110 km/h; the tier-5 English Wikipedia infobox publishes 105 km/h, so the two sources disagree and neither is averaged

payload_kg.state: payload published as 8.5 t; the tonne taken as 1,000 kg
